title: Columbia Artists tours and the money they brought
summary: Columbia Artists signed Hodes after the TV series and gave him subscription concert tours. The tours put him on his feet financially.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Do you think it's because you -- you got a lot of things going on now, it seems things are going fairly well. Do you see that coming from that TV series?
The TV series helped me, but times are changing.
You also got the Columbia Artist --

Columbia Artists caught me and brought me in New York because of the television series, they did. They brought me in New York because of that, and gave me the tours. And the tours put us on our feet financially. If I tell you what the stars were making, I don't want to say this because the sidemen weren't getting that, but they were getting more money than they could have gotten in a year of Sundays in Chicago.
Subscription concerts. So everybody was doing very well.
Yeah. And I wasn't spending my money, I had nothing to spend it on. So I was saving it, and the government didn't take it all away. They did leave me some. I discovered what paying taxes was.
